user.title: Add an app camera
user.description: Enter the go2rtc app's output_name. The app supplies MPEG-TS HLS and snapshots; camera credentials and media settings stay in the app. No Generic Camera is needed.

init.description: Select the app output. Encoding, HLS segment settings and warm buffering are configured in the app, not here. HA's standard preload setting can also keep this output warm.
